answer: Put commit-reveal with VDF for seed generation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the garden here is verification, the opal of cost is what stops the farm, and the summit of the record keeps every claim checkable. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
